rules.objective: Make the best five-card poker hand from your seven cards; wild cards substitute for any card.
rules.gameplay: Same as 7 Card Stud (two down, four up, one down; betting rounds). Designated cards (e.g. all deuces, one-eyed jacks) are wild. Showdown: best five-card hand wins.
keyRules: 7 Card Stud with wilds (e.g. deuces, one-eyed jacks)

strategy.basic: Wilds boost hand strength; play for straights, flushes, full houses.
strategy.intermediate: Count wilds on board; adjust for higher average hand.
strategy.advanced: Bluff with wilds; expect more boats and straights.
tips: Common wilds: deuces, one-eyed jacks; house rules vary.
Strong hands more common; bet accordingly.
